conventions.instrument: SkinColorCatch manufacturer D65 / 10-degree, original repo verified source_context.json
conventions.delta_e00: CIEDE2000 kL=kC=kH=1 between instrument Lab values only
conventions.published_image_lab: Only used for within-image nearest-neighbour selection; observer unknown in CSV dictionary; no cross-observer DeltaE metric computed

instrument_repeatability.assessment_interpretation: Dictionary documents 1st/2nd/3rd colorimeter assessments; unique recordings, but timing/repositioning/random independence is not encoded in tables.

single_assessment_vs_triplet_mean.warning: Same reading contributes to its reference, descriptive only

held_assessment_vs_other_two_mean.warning: Assesses single-reading vs two-reading mean disagreement, not a deployable color-model error floor

triplet_target_sensitivity_to_omitting_o.warning: Reference perturbation, not known latent truth

site_repeatability.independent_across_acquisition_site_reme: NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: one reference triplet per tag_id; no independent session repeated targets
site_repeatability.zero_pair_target_difference_interpretati: Label reuse; not evidence that repeatability noise or biological change equals zero.

oracles.name: same_site_leave_image_out
oracles.definition: Other image targets at exact patient+tag_id; shares the same S4 reference triplet, so zero is tautological.

oracles.name: same_site_nearest_observed
oracles.definition: Other exact-site image nearest in authors' published median image Lab Euclidean coordinates; reference triplet is shared.

oracles.name: patient_other_sites
oracles.definition: Equal-site mean of other unique measurement sites of same person, excluding all images sharing target site's reference.

oracles.name: patient_same_camera_other_sites
oracles.definition: Same-person/same-device other unique sites; camera is person-confounded, so equals patient oracle.

oracles.name: same_camera_anatomic_region_other_sites
oracles.definition: Mean of other unique TRAIN sites with same device and recorded anatomical region; target's exact tag_id excluded; references from other people are used.

oracles.name: same_site_leave_reference_observation_out
oracles.reason: Each exact site has one S4 triplet only; excluding its shared reference removes all same-site neighbours.

limitations: Only 24 independent people; comparisons within sites and pairs are dependent.
Three recorded assessments estimate short-term repeat disagreement, not calibrated accuracy against an external standard.
Same-site image oracles use the very same label acquisition and are tautologically perfect.
Do not subtract DeltaE00 repeatability from color-model DeltaE00 or claim a causal error-share percentage.
